handoff: All criteria met; review #1 F1-F3 resolved (log path via recordRunStatePath, record/S7 message via runStateRecord, whole-source lint). One minor: the lint's comment stripper misparses at regex literals (3 sources end unbalanced). Unit 1168, typecheck green, e2e 73/0.

findings.title: The lint's comment stripper loses track at regex literals that hold a quote or backtick
findings.detail:
stripComments treats every quote and backtick as opening a string or template, regex literals included. In packages/core/src/labels.ts:81 the `/'/g` inside a template's `${…}` puts it out of step. Running the same scanner over packages/*/src leaves its stack open at end of file in packages/store/src/worktree.ts, packages/adapters/src/exec.ts and packages/core/src/labels.ts, so from that point on comments may be kept or code blanked. The tree is green, so nothing is wrongly flagged today, but a bypass in those files' tails could go unseen.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Fail the lint (or warn) when the stack is not empty at end of file, so a misparse shows; or skip `/…/` regex literals in the scanner.
